item.title: AgentPolicyForge: From Executable Environments to Policy Benchmarks and Adaptive Guards
item.description:
AgentPolicyForge builds a framework that auto‑generates policy benchmarks and trains adaptive guard models to enforce custom rules in agent deployments. It creates PolicyGym, a dataset of 698 training and 254 test scenarios spanning ten policy families, proving that learned guards can detect policy violations better than prompt‑based instructions. This is relevant if you deploy AI agents that need to respect organisational policies.

IT Breakdown: If you manage AI‑enabled cloud tools, step 1: define your policy families; step 2: use AgentPolicyForge to generate training scenarios; step 3: deploy the trained guard to monitor tool calls and block violations.

item.title: [News] 1Password launches a way for AI agents to log in on your behalf without seeing your password
item.description: 1Password has unveiled an AI-powered login feature that lets AI agents access user accounts without revealing the underlying passwords. This reduces manual credential handling while maintaining security controls for personal and potentially corporate accounts.

item.title: [News] OpenAI makes its Jev competitor widely available as decision model competition heats up
item.description: OpenAI has released a new decision model, positioning it as a competitor in the emerging Jev-like decision‑model market. The model is intended for broad use, allowing developers to integrate advanced reasoning into their applications.

item.title: [News] Build more responsive apps with the Decisions API
item.description: OpenAI has launched a Decisions API that offers fast, low‑cost decision‑making capabilities for applications, allowing developers to embed AI logic without heavy infrastructure. The API is designed to streamline the integration of AI decisions into existing workflows.

item.title: [News] What FDE means at OpenAI
item.description: OpenAI has introduced forward-deployed engineering (FDE) to speed the deployment of new models and features directly into production. This approach emphasizes rapid iteration and real-time monitoring of model performance.

item.title: [News] Uber brings ChatGPT Work to all employees with OpenAI
item.description: Uber has rolled out ChatGPT Work to all 30,000 employees, enabling them to research, analyze data, create presentations, and automate complex workflows. This move introduces a powerful AI productivity tool that could influence internal collaboration and data handling practices across the organization.
